description: This file is the __init__.py for the torch.distributed.rpc module, containing functions and imports related to initializing and managing RPC (Remote Procedure Call) in PyTorch's distributed framework, including setup, backend selection, and debugging.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if the RPC subsystem is available in the current environment.

methods.name: init_rpc
methods.description: Initializes RPC primitives such as the local RPC agent and distributed autograd, making the current process ready to send and receive RPCs.

methods.name: _validate_rpc_args
methods.description: Validates the arguments for RPC backend initialization.

methods.name: _init_rpc_backend
methods.description: Initializes the RPC backend with specified parameters.

methods.name: _get_debug_info
methods.description: Collects debug information related to RRef context, current RPC agent, and autograd.
